===
Or binds looser than xor and and
===
a or b xor c and d
---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "or"
      X: (Ident "a")
      Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "xor"
        X: (Ident "b")
        Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "and"
          X: (Ident "c")
          Y: (Ident "d"))))))

===
Not binds looser than comparison
===
not a == b
---
(Root
  Nodes: (UnaryExpr Op: "not"
    X: (BinaryExpr Op: "=="
      X: (Ident "a")
      Y: (Ident "b"))))

===
Not with and
===
not a and b
---
(Root
  Nodes: (BinaryExpr Op: "and"
    X: (UnaryExpr Op: "not"
      X: (Ident "a"))
    Y: (Ident "b")))

===
Comparison binds looser than shift
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "=="
      X: (Ident "a")

        Y: (Ident "c")))))

===
Comparison chain is left associative
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "<"
      X: (BinaryExpr Op: "<"
        X: (Ident "a")
        Y: (Ident "b"))
      Y: (Ident "c"))))

===
Rotate left
===

(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt

      Y: (ValueLiteral "3"))))

===
Rotate right
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "@>"

      Y: (ValueLiteral "3"))))

===
Shift binds looser than concatenation
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "<<"
      X: (Ident "a")
      Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "&"

        Y: (Ident "c")))))

===
Concatenation is left associative
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "&"
      X: (BinaryExpr Op: "&"
        X: (Ident "a")
        Y: (Ident "b"))
      Y: (Ident "c"))))

===
Concatenation and addition have equal precedence
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "+"
      X: (BinaryExpr Op: "&"
        X: (Ident "a")
        Y: (Ident "b"))
      Y: (Ident "c"))))

===
Addition and subtraction left associative
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "+"
      X: (BinaryExpr Op: "-"
        X: (Ident "a")
        Y: (Ident "b"))
      Y: (Ident "c"))))

===
Mixed arithmetic precedence
===

---
(Root
  Nodes: (BinaryExpr Op: "-"
    X: (BinaryExpr Op: "+"
      X: (ValueLiteral "1")
      Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "*"
        X: (ValueLiteral "2")
        Y: (ValueLiteral "3")))
    Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "/"
      X: (ValueLiteral "4")
      Y: (ValueLiteral "2"))))

===
Mixed logical and relational
===

(Root
  Nodes: (ExprStmt
    Expr: (BinaryExpr Op: "or"
      X: (BinaryExpr Op: "and"

          X: (Ident "a")
          Y: (Ident "b"))
        Y: (BinaryExpr Op: ">"
          X: (Ident "c")
          Y: (Ident "d")))
      Y: (BinaryExpr Op: "=="
        X: (Ident "e")
        Y: (Ident "f")))))

===
Real-world: guarded arithmetic
===
(lengthof(buf) - offset) mod 8 == 0 and not ispresent(x.opt)
---
(Root
  Nodes: (BinaryExpr Op: "and"
    X: (BinaryExpr Op: "=="
      X: (BinaryExpr Op: "mod"
        X: (ParenExpr
          List: (BinaryExpr Op: "-"
            X: (CallExpr
              Fun: (Ident "lengthof")
              Args: (ParenExpr
                List: (Ident "buf")))
            Y: (Ident "offset")))
        Y: (ValueLiteral "8"))
      Y: (ValueLiteral "0"))
    Y: (UnaryExpr Op: "not"
      X: (CallExpr
        Fun: (Ident "ispresent")
        Args: (ParenExpr
          List: (SelectorExpr
            X: (Ident "x")
            Sel: (Ident "opt")))))))

===
Real-world: bit manipulation
===
(flags and4b '00001111'B) or4b (mask << 4)
---
(Root
  Nodes: (BinaryExpr Op: "or4b"
    X: (ParenExpr
      List: (BinaryExpr Op: "and4b"
        X: (Ident "flags")
        Y: (ValueLiteral "'00001111'B")))
    Y: (ParenExpr
      List: (BinaryExpr Op: "<<"
        X: (Ident "mask")
        Y: (ValueLiteral "4")))))

              Fun: (Ident "f")
              Args: (ParenExpr))))))))
